pageCache.pageTitle: Springmead School | Co-ed Prep School, Frome
pageCache.text:
Open Morning at Springmead School and Nursery
Join us on Tuesday 17th November, 9am–11am, to explore our classrooms, meet our teachers and see what a Springmead morning looks like.
Enrichment Week
Our enrichment week was a great success, building knowledge and respect for our natural world.
Our Next Reception Class Open Event
If you are considering our Reception class ready for 2027, we would be very pleased to hear from you and would like to invite you to see what we offer on an individual tour or at an open event. Our open event specifically for these families is Friday 27th November from 2.30pm to 3.30pm.
Welcome to Springmead Preparatory School
An award-winning, co-educational independent preparatory school and nursery, we welcome children from 6 months to 11 years.
Our on-site Nursery, Little Crickets at Springmead School, achieved Highly Commended in the 2024 Independent School Association awards for Excellence and Innovation in Early Years welcomes children from 6 months old.
We are a small school with a big ambition, situated in the beautiful village of Beckington, near Frome, on the Wiltshire – Somerset border. Our vision is to ignite a passion for learning and for life in every child. This happens every day through exciting, engaging lessons and through the wide range of enrichment activities available to the children.
Children who are enthusiastic and engaged
The inspectors clearly recognised and celebrated the values and aims that sit at the heart of our school, as well as the happy and purposeful atmosphere that defines daily life here.
We Achieve Results
We are proud of our academic achievements, and rightly so. Our pupils leave Springmead with strong academic outcomes and succeed at entrance to many selective independent senior schools.
We Are Award-Winning
Our approach is admirable and our hard work pays off. Over the last five years we have won and have been shortlisted for many awards including the Independent Schools Association (ISA) Award for Excellence and Innovation in Early Years, and the Pupil Personal Development Award to name but a few.
A Holistic Education
As a testament to our commitment to holistic approach to learning in 2022 we were shortlisted for the National ISA Award for Excellence and Innovation in Early Years.
Enriching the Curriculum
Research shows that extra-curricular activities help pupils to develop life skills that benefit them right through to adulthood, in their professional, social and academic careers. Springmead offers an exciting curriculum with many opportunities.
Go Explore!
Respect for the environment cannot be taught in a classroom. Rich learning experiences occur every week through our Go Explore! programme. Throughout school, children integrate outside learning with different areas of the curriculum, making learning meaningful and memorable.
Experience more at Springmead Preparatory School
"Cross country is a strength; pupils compete in local leagues and the school has produced some excellent runners and swimmers who have gained scholarships to leading sports facilities." - Muddy Stilettos
"Springmead school has been such a positive influence on my children. Their exposure to the arts and sport at a young age has helped build their confidence." - A parent
"Pupils are highly successful and make strong progress in relation to their abilities. This excellent achievement is a result of the expert and skilful teaching provided by leaders." - ISI Inspection, 2023
Social

pageCache.pageTitle: Philosophy and Aims | Co-ed Prep School, Frome
pageCache.text:
Our Philosophy and Aims
Children learn best when they feel safe and supported and their individual talents are nurtured, valued and developed.
Our philosophy is that at Springmead School, children should not only become numerate and literate, but also develop a hunger for knowledge and a thirst for learning whether this is in academic areas, sports or arts.
We support our children to become self-learners, to think wisely, be confident, balanced and compassionate, while developing their own particular talents and abilities to the full. Such principles are best achieved in an environment that is stable, secure and safe, but at the same time one that is exciting, rich, stimulating, rewarding and fun such as Springmead School and Little Crickets Nursery.
Our Aims
At Springmead School our philosophy is achieved by having the following clearly defined aims:
To teach children in small classes
To provide dedicated, professional and caring staff
Our Philosophy and Aims
listItems: To teach children in small classes

pageCache.text:
Outdoor Learning
Getting outdoors with Go Explore!
At Springmead we recognise the need to be immersed in a location that stimulates every sense, to feel part of it and to wonder and be amazed by whatever you find.
These rich learning experiences occur every week through our Go Explore! programme for all pupils up to Year 5. Throughout the whole school, the children integrate outside learning with different areas of the curriculum to make learning meaningful and memorable. Den building, river dipping and walks are just some of the exciting outdoor learning activities that the children take part in throughout the year.
Countrylore
Mark and Lucy Hotson, former parents, are our Bushcraft leaders who run our Countrylore programme and work with our Year 6 children throughout the year. They have specialist knowledge within this area and their enthusiasm is inspiring for both children and staff. Mark himself trained with Ray Mears.
To inspire and truly connect children with nature, they have devised a programme which combines Bushcraft and country lore with the National Curriculum. Over the academic year, they work closely with the staff and older children to impart age-old traditions that are rich in exciting learning opportunities.
Enriching the Curriculum
Outdoor Learning

Wraparound Care
School starts at 8:30am. However, parents can drop children off from 8:00am in the knowledge that care is provided by the Springmead teachers.
For families who require cover to the end of the working day, Springmead offers after-school care until 6.00pm. Whether your child chooses the planned activities provided by the teacher or prefers to read, watch a video, play a game or just catch up with friends, you are safe in the knowledge that you will only pay for the cover you use, making this facility a cost-effective option.
Children staying to be collected after 3.30pm, are served high tea at 4pm.

ISI Inspection
Springmead School had its most recent Independent School's Inspectorate (ISI) inspection in January 2026. The inspection team spent three days completing their assessment of the school and nursery. We are proud to say that pupils demonstrated not only their talents and hard work, but also their kindness, curiosity and joy in learning. We are delighted with the wonderful comments shared in the report that highlighted how well the school and nursery meets its aims and values for both the quality of pupils’ academic achievements and pupils’ personal development.
In every inspection since Springmead School and Nursery opened in 2002 we have been awarded Excellent or Outstanding.
The full report is available to read below. To visit us, to see all Springmead School offers, please follow this link.

pageCache.pageTitle: Springmead Preparatory School - The Creative Arts
pageCache.text:
The Creative Arts
Art
Each child has a hands-on opportunity to experience a wide range of art forms, both in the class and through the many co-curricular opportunities on offer. We regularly invite local artists to work with our children with inspiring results. We have won significant awards for our Art in National competitions for the last years running. Our new art studio is an impressive addition to our school. It provides a dedicated space. The children relish these chances to explore their creativity and enjoy seeing their work exhibited around the school with bright and inspiring displays.
Drama
Drama plays an important part in school life; at all ages, children are given the opportunity to perform in front of the class, in regular class performances and school assemblies and in annual productions within the Nursery, Pre-Prep and Prep departments. The children regularly compete in our inter-house Poetry Competition as well as competing in local poetry and prose competitions, including the Mid-Somerset Festival. Additionally, children have the opportunity to work with our specialist Speech and Drama teacher who helps them work towards LAMDA exams.
Music
Music is a key part of Springmead School and is taught in all classes. In addition, children can take individual lessons for musical instruments as co-curricular subjects with visiting teachers. More than half the children at our school play a musical instrument or have individual singing lessons.
From Reception, children can join the Pre-Prep Choir and develop further musical skills by joining relevant extra mural clubs. The Prep Choir regularly attend music festivals, and have celebrated winning at the Young People’s Festival in Salisbury and at the Mid Somerset Festival in Bath. It’s a wonderful experience to be able to compete on these occasions and to be able to immerse ourselves in the musical experience.
In Year 2, children begin to read music and play the ocarina and the recorder.
There are many performing opportunities for young musicians, including recitals, church services, special assemblies, a yearly music concert and a yearly showcase concert.

pageCache.pageTitle: Academic Excellence | Springmead School, Leading Independent Frome School
pageCache.text:
Academic Excellence
Pupils are highly motivated learners with a deep thirst for knowledge.
A fundamental requirement of a preparatory school is to fully prepare pupils for entrance exams to independent senior schools. At Springmead, academic progress through the years is monitored through teacher assessments and through nationally recognised external GL assessment tests. These assessments cover reading, spelling, writing, reading comprehension and maths.
Children from Year 1 to Year 6 sit age-appropriate formal tests each year; these are correlated to SATS statistics, so we can get a benchmark on our performance against nationally recognised grades. Whilst we do not believe in the practice of ‘teaching to tests’, we do believe that children should have test experience each year. Springmead prepares children for the testing environment by making tests routine and good practice, ensuring children are supported and challenged in order for them to reach the best outcomes.
The school consistently achieves above the national average in all subjects. Assessment information is shared with parents at parent consultation evenings and on school reports.
Entrance Exams
Pupils in Year 6 who are applying to selective, senior independent schools also have weekly preparation sessions with our experienced teaching staff to practice entrance tests and interview techniques.
We are proud that all children whose families have wanted them to gain entry to senior independent schools have been successful.
Teaching and Learning
Academic Excellence

pageCache.pageTitle: Teaching and Learning | Springmead School, Leading Somerset Prep School in Beckington
pageCache.text:
Teaching and Learning
Academic Excellence
Springmead School provides a safe and happy learning environment where respect, patience, self-discipline, tolerance and a joy for learning are given high priority; at our school we have lots of fun without jeopardising academic success.
It is our job to help to shape our youngsters’ characters so that they become fulfilled learners with positive self-esteem and a passion for life and learning. At Springmead School we educate the whole child.
Small classes with a maximum of 18 children and specialist teachers ensures all of our children’s educational needs are met.
Teaching and Learning

pageCache.text:
Enriching the Curriculum
The very heart of the Springmead vision is to ignite in our children a passion for learning and life. This happens every day through exciting lessons delivered by knowledgeable and enthusiastic staff. Importantly, it also happens through the wide range of enrichment activities that they experience during each academic year. We ensure that these opportunities are explicitly taught using our learning objectives and the skills, knowledge and concepts are assessed accordingly. These activities are integral to our curriculum and often include:
Our enrichment programme is complementary to their learning and includes our Extra Curricular programme, trips and visits and our outdoor learning programmes, Go Explore! and Countrylore sessions.
School poetry performance competitions
Charity gift boxes
Science fair
Online-safety day
Subject enrichment days
Christmas gift shop
School council
Annual productions and class performances
Instrumental concerts
Charity events throughout the year
Award activities
Extra mural clubs
Sports day and sports clubs
Enriching the Curriculum

Holiday Club
Our Holiday Club is for all children and is led by our experienced Springmead teachers and staff, offering children a safe, welcoming and fun‑filled day packed with engaging activities. What’s new is that our programme will be even more flexible and responsive — with activities changing throughout the year and adapting to the weather, so no two days ever feel the same. From creative play to outdoor adventures, there’s always something to look forward to.
Our standard Holiday Club day runs from 8:00am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday, during published holiday periods (excluding Bank Holidays).
Alongside our regular Holiday Club days, we also run separate WOW Days – exciting themed experiences that bring an extra sense of adventure to the holidays. These new days are inspired by highlights such as Pirate Parties, Multi‑Sports Days, Pottery workshops, “Musical in a Day” experiences and other creative themes, WOW Days offer children memorable, stand‑out activities which are advertised in advance and priced according to the experience.
When booking, we kindly ask parents to provide an approximate pick‑up time. This helps our team plan afternoon activities so the children get the most out of every session.
Payment will be requested via invoice at the end of each month in which the Holiday Club runs.
If you have any questions or would like to know more, please don’t hesitate to contact us at office@springmead.com — we’re always happy to help.
We’re really looking forward to welcoming the children and making each holiday club day an enjoyable and memorable experience!
For more information and how to book, please email office@springmead.com.
Drop‑off from 8:00am and collection by 5:00pm

Our Nursery
Little Crickets Nursery at Springmead School, Beckington, Frome.
Springmead School's on-site nursery, Little Crickets Nursery, Frome, is the perfect place for curious minds and little explorers aged from 6 months old. There are many new skills to learn at a nursery provision; Little Crickets offers spacious play rooms and plenty of learning opportunities for all children to develop.
Please click here to visit our Little Crickets Nursery admissions page.
Moreover, when your child joins the Springmead School family at Little Crickets, this is their first step in developing them as they move through to the main school. Our experienced nursery practitioners ensure that your child is taught the skills required so that they are ready to start school in Reception.
Click here to visit our Little Crickets Frome website.
Baby Explore!
Come along to our baby group, Baby Explore!. We welcome babies of all ages and are free for families to attend. Offering a stimulating environment to babies, and the opportunity to meet other parents in the community, Baby Explore! is the perfect way to spend a Thursday morning during term time! Click here for more information and to book.

Enrichment Week
Our enrichment week was a great success, building knowledge and respect for our natural world.
We were delighted to welcome David, a parent and ambassador to several wildlife trusts, who visited us to help celebrate the forthcoming 100th birthday of Sir David Attenborough. David spoke to the children in two groups, sharing his own experiences of working to promote and protect the natural world, as well as stories from his travels and encounters with wildlife. pageCache.pageTitle: Springmead Preparatory School - Investing in the Future
pageCache.text:
Investing in the Future
In 2023, Springmead School was acquired by Forfar Education Group, a forward-thinking organisation that owns and manages schools across the UK and Europe. This means that Springmead benefits from guidance, governance and support from the experienced Forfar team.
With access to a broad range of resources, skills and expertise across all schools, we collaborate and share best practice. Not only is this a brilliant opportunity for staff development and training, but it also provides excellent inter-school activities, from debating competitions, music, sport and outdoor learning.
Recently, Springmead has benefited from significant investment in its art facilities and has a brand-new classroom for art and Design Technology, as well as new computer equipment too.
More about Forfar Education
Forfar develops inspiring schools which teach self-belief and deliver academic excellence. Forfar’s schools equip children with the confidence and resourcefulness that prepares them to grow, thrive and find success in an ever-changing world. This approach ensures that the needs of each child are at the heart of our schools to create friendly, welcoming communities that empower children with the tools to be successful.
If you would like further information about Forfar Education please contact the Chairman, John Forsyth, directly at jf@forfareducation.co.uk or telephone 07443 103805.
Investing in the Future

pageCache.pageTitle: Springmead Preparatory School - Preparatory: Year 3 to Year 6
pageCache.text:
Preparatory: Year 3 to Year 6
The Prep department offers children from Year 3 to Year 6 the potential to explore a wide range of activities and educational experiences. The ethos and atmosphere is one of happy purposefulness within a lively school schedule. Strong emphasis is placed on creating a friendly and supportive environment in which pupils can develop their self-esteem and talents to the full.
In small class sizes, all with qualified class teachers, children also spend time with subject specialists for physical education, music, French and science. In this department, children will:
The rigours of study increase in the Prep department with more curriculum time being devoted to all subjects. Some subjects are taught through themes to give meaningful context to the children’s studies. However, care is taken not to lose subject identity.
Take part in the Springmead Award
Continue weekly swimming lessons
Take on positions of responsibility in school
Prepare for entrance exams to senior schools
Entrance Exams
Throughout their time in the Prep department children are being prepared for entrance examinations to senior schools. This is not a ‘hothouse process’ but simply the result of consistent teaching and learning. Children are continually assessed to enable us to plan for their next stage of learning. We offer an entrance test club to support children in Year 6.
Homework is fundamental to encouraging children to become independent learners. The amount of homework children receive increases gradually, but never excessively, through the Prep department. We offer Prep clubs two nights a week run by a qualified teacher to support children and families.

pageCache.pageTitle: Springmead Preparatory School - Pupil Leadership Opportunities
pageCache.text:
Pupil Leadership Opportunities
School Council
Springmead School Council is made up of children from Years 1 to 6 and supports children to develop their voice by expressing their views on matters that affect them. Children are elected onto the School Council by their fellow pupils, and each pupil enjoys the opportunity to play a vital role in addressing topics and issues within the school community.
From Reception, pupils enjoy the opportunity to become Digital Leaders, and from Year 3, they can join the Eco Committee.
The Springmead Award
In Year 5 and 6 we have a specific leadership programme as part of the Springmead Award. Children are expected to complete leadership elements
In Year 6, pupils are selected to become Springmead Ambassadors, a role that they take immense pride in!
Enriching the Curriculum
Pupil Leadership Opportunities

pageCache.pageTitle: Springmead Preparatory School - Pre-Prep: Reception to Year 2
pageCache.text:
Pre-Prep: Reception to Year 2
The Pre-Prep School provides a happy and stimulating introduction to school for children aged 4 to 7 years. The three classes in this department are Reception class, Year One and Year Two.
As the children move into the Pre-Prep School, they benefit from a maximum class size of 18 with their own qualified class teacher, supported by teaching assistants and specialist teachers for some subjects.
Small classes enable the class teacher to provide a one-to-one education tailored to the needs of each child so that individual potential can be nurtured and realised.
As well as enjoying a rich curriculum, delivered through a combination of child-led and adult-led activities, in this department children will have the opportunity to:
In Reception, children learn through exciting and stimulating themes that incorporate the seven areas of learning in the Early Years Foundation Stage curriculum. Music, P.E and French are introduced as fun activities by specialist teachers.
In Years 1 and 2, children are taught through themes and separate subjects by class teachers and specialist teachers. Whatever the subject, the aim is to make each lesson a rewarding and inspiring experience for the children. Importantly at Springmead School we are teaching our children to become successful learners, so learning to learn skills are embedded into our curriculum.
Begin weekly swimming lessons
Sing and perform in our Pre-Prep choir
Be involved in music and drama productions
Spring Adventure Reception Class Discovery Session: Friday 6th March, 2pm to 3pm
Join us for a special opportunity to meet the Reception class teacher, discover our engaging story time, explore the learning environment, and enjoy some exciting Spring adventures.
